SELECT scb.scb_name, m.organization_name, m.primary_activity_name, scb.ncd_id FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb JOIN chatbot_scb_members_private m ON scb.id = m.state_cooperative_bank_id WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 1 AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0;

SELECT dm.name as bank_name, scb.scb_registration_no, scb.state_name, scb.registration_date, scb.ncd_id, scb.rbi_license, scb.rbi_license_date, scb.ifsc_code FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb JOIN chatbot_dccb_master_private dm ON scb.id = dm.id WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 2 AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0;
